subject: [PATCH 18/60] mm/khugepaged: base the recommended min_free_kbytes on common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the handling of memory fragmentation in the kernel's khugepaged functionality, which is responsible for splitting large pages into smaller ones. The current implementation reserves two pageblocks per populated zone to help THP allocations avoid fragmentation. This patch specifically modifies the set_recommended_min_free_kbytes() function to only count zones on N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes, as these are the ones that use ordinary memory.

reviews.author: Yury Norov
reviews.summary: Suggested refactoring the code to avoid duplicated checks and improve readability. Proposed a new macro for iterating over populated zones with specific node states.
reviews.raw_body:
On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 01:09:09PM -0500, Gregory Price via B4 Relay wrote:
> From: "Gregory Price (Meta)" <gourry@gourry.net>
> 
> set_recommended_min_free_kbytes() reserves two pageblocks per populated
> zone to help THP allocations avoid fragmentation. The reserve serves
> ordinary allocations, which use only common memory, so count only the
> zones on N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes.
> 
> Signed-off-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>
> ---
>  mm/khugepaged.c | 3 +++
>  1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)
> 
> diff --git a/mm/khugepaged.c b/mm/khugepaged.c
> index 2dc4245814df..a930d99f89da 100644
> --- a/mm/khugepaged.c
> +++ b/mm/khugepaged.c
> @@ -3151,6 +3151,9 @@ void set_recommended_min_free_kbytes(void)
>  	}
>  
>  	for_each_populated_zone(zone) {
> +		if (!node_state(zone_to_nid(zone), N_MEMORY_COMMON))
> +			continue;

This is the 2nd time you add this check. Maybe fold it into the
for_each()? Assuming, you keep N_MEMORY meaning unchanged, that would
look like:

 #define for_each_populated_zone_state(zone, state)            \
         for (zone = (first_online_pgdat())->node_zones;       \
              zone;                                            \
              zone = next_zone(zone))                          \
                 if (!populated_zone(zone) ||                  \
                     !node_state(zone_to_nid(zone), state))    \
                         ; /* do nothing */                    \
                 else 
 
 #define for_each_populated_n_memory_zone(zone)                \
            for_each_populated_zone_state(zone, N_MEMORY)


>  		/*
>  		 * We don't need to worry about fragmentation of
>  		 * ZONE_MOVABLE since it only has movable pages.
> 
> -- 
> 2.56.1
>

2026-11-22.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the handling of memory allocation for Transparent Huge Pages (THP) in the Linux kernel. Specifically, it proposes a change to base the recommended minimum free kbytes on common memory nodes. This is done by adding a check to ensure that only zones on N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes are considered when reserving pageblocks for THP allocations.
